qualified_claim: On this Linux host, cooperating same-UID Remote Access windows/processes admit one provisioning setup per radio, retain authority through the issued-token save result, and reload credentials before sending. Actual cross-process locks and OS keychain were exercised with injected network replies only.
original_failures: At base 7502ee2e7, two production windows could send overlapping provision requests; the new before test failed. The shim existing race-tested regression confirms that an unfinished legacy QR sign-in can be restarted with a different token.

At the intermediate admission implementation, a delayed claimable/error status restarted setup after a busy manual-key refusal. The added test failed before marking the attempt tried. The first needs_login vector did not meet automatic-sign-in eligibility and correctly did not reproduce this case.

implementation.admission: Nonblocking shared per-serial QLockFile authority via the existing validated UID namespace. Distinct from the credential-store transaction lock; no lock is taken on the radio.
implementation.lifetime: Application-owned request and save completion retain admission after the window closes or the HTTP reply finishes. Busy/unavailable admission reports refusal before starting a provision request; no request is queued for automatic retry.
implementation.freshness: Reload the keychain under setup admission before sending. Original-session retirement or a newer window operation during that load prevents the request.
implementation.managed_reply: Refuse an unexpected installation ID or changed owner token before saving. The previously saved credential remains.
implementation.automatic_restart: Mark an explicit setup attempt as tried before admission so a delayed public status cannot silently turn a busy refusal into QR provisioning.
implementation.bounds: No empty/over-512-byte serial; existing bounded keychain admission and HTTP transfer limits. No new thread, dependency, GUI/core include or on-radio privilege.

verification.registered_CTests: 3/3 passed; final-test.log. Window test injects admission and transport; no OS keychain or process-lock files in that default test.
verification.server_contract: Existing TestANeverCompletedSignInCanBeStartedOverWithoutTheToken passed under go test -race, socket-free, no real tailnet. Initial sandbox cache setup failure retained separately.

real_process_cases.sanitizer_scope: ASan/UBSan/LSan on the harness and changed window, client, token-store and persistence translation units. Unmodified linked application/Qt libraries are not asserted to be fully instrumented.
real_process_cases.caller_crash_scope: SIGKILL of a fixture caller before delivery of its injected reply; does not prove completion or recovery of a real remote operation after a crash.
